description: Converts between a human decimal amount and integer base units, using the asset's decimals read LIVE from the chain (never assumed from a symbol). Refuses to round: more decimal places than the asset has is an error. An ambiguous symbol returns AMBIGUOUS_INPUT.

chain.description: Aptos CAIP-2 id: aptos:1 (mainnet, default) or aptos:2 (testnet)

name: aptos_amount_convert
title: Convert an Aptos amount
